info.title: Melt task wallet API
info.description: Owner-authorized wallets for browser tasks. Agent keys operate existing sessions in their account and cannot create wallets or increase spending limits. Financial writes require status and outcome inspection; HTTP success alone is not proof of execution. Download the dependency-free client at /api/client.mjs; no npm package is required.
